pages.text: Display Notches can be altered from Item Frames and Glow Item Frames. These can be placed on any side of a block. Once an item is inserted, there are several ways to manipulate the display: Dyes will change the color of the notch; an Axe can change between the item laying flat or standing; a Pickaxe can change the rotation of the item; a Shovel can change the elevation of it; a Glow Ink Sac will make the item glow; a

Phantom Membrane will make  the Notch itself immaterial; a Tripwire Hook will lock it, stopping all other interactions; and lastly, being powered by a Redstone signal will cause the item to rotate continuously.
